items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: then we add drums, either Bernard Purdie or Dennis Mackrel or Joe Cocuzzo

ctx.x: And these days, you split your time between going around to these jazz parties and doing recording. Have you got a recording session planned coming up?

No the only records we make now for companies that want to make a jazz record like Arbors or the company I used to be with, LRC Records with New York Swing, it’s John Bunch and Jay Leonhart, just a trio, and then we add drums, either Bernard Purdie or Dennis Mackrel or Joe Cocuzzo. But we found out that it works better on the road with just three, without the drums.
